tei:div.tei:p: #!"# ༄༅// byad 'grol gser gyi lde mig gi rgyun khyer zab don snying po bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru badz+roṣ+ṇī ṣa ya/ skyabs sems ni/ bla ma mchog gsum yi dam lhar// gus pas skyabs mchi mkha' mnyam 'gro /bla med byang chub mchog thob phyir// rdo rje gtsug tor bsgom par bgyi// lan gsum/ sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*// chos kun mnyam nyid rtog par shog / ces tshad med bzhi bsgom/ dngos gzhi ni/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje gtsug tor dbu stong dang ldan pa/ spyan bye ba brgya phrag 'bum gyis mtshan pa/ phyag stong gis gcod byed kyi ral gri 'bar ba bsnams pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dkyil na brkyang bskum gyad kyi rol pas bzhugs pa/ khro bo'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing srid gsum zil gyis non pa'i bdag nyid du gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po las rnam par snang mdzad/ mgrin par āḥdamar po las snang ba mtha' yas/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po las rdo rje sems dpa'/ ya so hūm̐ las khro bo bcu/ ma so hrīḥlas khro mo bcu/ lce ral gri ngar ma/ sma ra me phung 'bar ba/ mgrin par nyi ma dang zla bas mtshan pa/ sngags bzlas pa tsam gyis sku'i cha thams cad las me phung 'bar zhing 'khrugs pas lus ngag yid gsum la gnod pa'i rigs thams cad bya sgro mes bsreg pa bzhin thal ba bun bun du song bar gyur/ spro zhing nus na gzungs ring thung dang*/ gang ltar yang*/ tad+ya thā: oṃ a na le a na le: bhi ṣa dhe bhi ṣa dhe: dpe gcig la shud+dhe snang*/ bhai ra bhai ra: badz+ra dhā ra ṇi: bhan+dha bhan+dha ni: badz+ra pā ṇi phaṭa: hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā: hūm̐ drūṃ bhan+dha bhan+dha phaṭa swā hā: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: zhes rtsa sngags ci nus dang*/ mthar/ oṃ badz+ra kā ya gling zlog: lus bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol:

oṃ badz+ra hi baṃ gar+bha ya zlog: ngag bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ badz+ra hi ka nan zlog: yid bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa thams cad sarba a pa na ye swā hā: zhes sku gsung thugs kyi snying po'i byad 'grol dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ kā ya wāk+tsit+ta k+sha ya badz+ra: tshin+dha tsa hā: shān+tiṃ shān+tiṃ: shag byer: yar yar s+t+waṃ bha ya byer: dzaṃ bha ya byer: mo ha ya byer: ya zlog bh+yo: zhes byad 'grol yang snying rnams kyang bzlas mthar/ ban bon sngags pa'i bsam sbyor ngan pas mnan pa dang: bcings pa dang: bsdams pa dang: gzir pa dang: byad du bcug pa thams cad phye phye khrol khrol swā hā: gnod pa'i rigs thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: phye phye khrol khrol: mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sarba a pa na ye swā hā: zhes sham 'dogs dang bcas pa'ang cung zad bzlas la/ tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa'i bum chu yod na rang gzhan la khrus bya/ rjes bsdu rim ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas snang cha'i lha sku 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i dbyings su thim par bsam la gnas lugs kyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag /thun mtshams la 'jug pa'i tshe/ slar yang rang skad cig gis khro rgyal rdo rje gtsug tor gyi skur gyur/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje gtsug tor 'grub gyur nas// sogs bsngo smon shis brjod ji ltar rigs pa bya'o// zhes pa'ang gter gzhung rtsa ba'i dgongs pa brgyud ldan bla ma'i zhal lung ltar ('jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po/)snying por dril pa dge /maṅga laṃ/// /
